newsitem.title: USA: Conrail sells Flexi-Flo transfer facilities.
newsitem.headline: Conrail sells Flexi-Flo transfer facilities.

text.p: Conrail Inc said it sold 14 rail-to-truck transfer facilities to Savage Industries Inc and Matlack Systems Inc for undisclosed terms.
The two companies will become the owners and operators of 14 Flexi-Flo transfer terminals in 11 cities, Conrail said.

The terminals handle a variety of bulk commodities, including chemicals, food and grain products, plastic pellets, and construction materials, it said, adding they plan to expand operating hours at each terminal.

To assure a seamless transition for customers, each of the 14 terminals will continue to be open to all common and private motor carriers, each will continue to handle the commodities it does today, and existing contracts with customers will be honored. The actual transfer of operational responsibility and ownership will be phased in through mid-1997, beginning later this year with the facility at Indianapolis.

Matlack is purchasing the facilities in Baltimore, Jersey City, and Pittsburgh. Savage Industries is purchasing the facilities in Boston and South Boston, two in Buffalo, Cleveland, Detroit, Indianapolis, Jeffersonville, Indiana, two in Philadelphia, and Syracuse.
